concepts.summary: Man beater built on the tagged man's Faulk at 5: he works to win inside and only goes over the top as a last resort. A Shallow Cross at 5 runs under him and a Clear takes the lid off; the backside Bench at 18 to 20 widens as the alert. The call is paired with a zone answer by the Can word, but the page does not name it.
concepts.progression: 1 Faulk, 2 Shallow Cross, 3 Clear; Bench is the alert; Check Wide outlet
concepts.qb: Dropback. Can to the zone answer when the look is not man.

positions.tagged: Faulk at 5 yds from the -5- spot: win inside first, over the top only as a last resort (F or Z)
positions.clear: Clear (H in the first cell, F in the second)
positions.bench: Widen, Bench at 18 to 20 yds, alert
positions.H: Check Wide, outlet; Flat at 2 to 3 yds in the empty cell

concepts.summary: 3x1 Faulk. The tagged man runs Faulk at 5 (inside first, over the top last) with a Dunny at 5 and a Shallow Cross at 5 around him; X runs a Comeback at 18 with an outside release as the alert. Corner swaps the Dunny for a Y Corner at 12. Speck adds Specials. Can to the zone answer, not named on the page.
concepts.progression: 1 Faulk, 2 Dunny or Corner, 3 Shallow Cross; Comeback is the alert; Check Wide outlet
concepts.qb: Dropback. Comeback alert outside. Can to the zone answer.

positions.X: Comeback at 18 yds, outside release, alert
positions.Y: Dunny at 5 yds; Corner at 12 yds when tagged; Special in the Speck cell

concepts.summary: X is alone on the backside with a 3-step Slant or a Sluggo as the first read. Duck is the four-man side: two Unders at 5 with a Corner at 12 as the alert and a wide clear. H comes across on a Hover or Fly motion (Hover or Bolt).
concepts.progression: 1 X Slant or Sluggo, 2 Under, 3 Under; Corner is the alert
concepts.qb: Dropback. Start on X, then the Unders. Can to the zone answer.

positions.X: Slant in 3 steps (Slant cell); Sluggo in 3 steps (Sluggo cell)
positions.unders: Under at 5 yds, two of them (Z and F or Z and Y, unclear)
positions.H: Hover or Fly motion into the four-man side

concepts.summary: Dancer is a Go on a max split (Yes/No) with a Seam at 10 to 12 and a Diagonal next to it; Trash is the backside Shallow Cross at 5 marked as the man alert. Switch has the Seam and Go widen and trade releases, with a printed order: X first, F second, Z third. H checks trail.
concepts.progression: 1 Diagonal, 2 Seam, 3 Shallow Cross; Go is Yes/No
concepts.qb: Dropback. Go is Yes/No; Shallow Cross is the alert against man. Can to the zone answer.

positions.seam: Seam at 10 to 12 yds; widen Seam in Switch
positions.shallow: Shallow Cross at 5 yds, alert vs man
positions.H: Check Trail; Rib Trail in the Lick cell
positions.switch order: X releases first, F second, Z third

alerts: Shallow Cross is the alert vs man

concepts.summary: Empty man beater: the Choice at 5 is the first read with a Diagonal next to it. Coin at 5 or Steal fills the third spot and a Bench at 18 to 20 and a Go are alerts. Releases follow a traffic pattern (Z first, X second, F third) to make the defender miss a count. The Steal cell adds a Locked Thunder at 6 with a Stomp.
concepts.progression: 1 Choice, 2 Diagonal, 3 Coin or Steal; Bench and Go are alerts
concepts.qb: Dropback. Go is Yes/No. Can to the zone answer.

positions.thunder: Locked Thunder at 6 yds with Stomp (second cell)
positions.traffic: Z goes first, X second, F third

alerts: Release order makes the defender miss a count

concepts.summary: Same empty shell as Choice Diagonal with Swim in place of Choice. Swim shows as a Money at 5 with a Swirl at 10 and 15 beside the Diagonal; Coin at 5 or Steal with a Locked Thunder at 6 fills the rest. Same traffic pattern: Z, then X, then F.
concepts.progression: 1 Swim (Money), 2 Diagonal, 3 Coin or Steal; Go is Yes/No
concepts.qb: Dropback. Go is Yes/No. Can to the zone answer.

positions.swim: Money at 5 yds with a Swirl at 10 and 15 yds; which letter has which is unclear (F or Y tagged)
positions.diagonal: Diagonal, 18 to 20 yd mark in the first cell
positions.thunder: Locked Thunder at 6 yds with Stomp (second cell)
positions.traffic: Z goes first, X second, F third

alerts: Alerts printed on both cells, targets unclear

concepts.summary: F runs Pressure, a 10 to 12 yd route, as the first read. The outside man runs a Go on a max split with a Clear alert, and Trash is the Shallow Cross at 5 on the backside marked as an alert. H checks trail.
concepts.progression: 1 Pressure, 2 Check Trail, 3 Shallow Cross; Go is the Clear alert
concepts.qb: Dropback. Can to the zone answer.

concepts.summary: Y runs a Go to clear. Snag at 5 is the first read, a Basic at 12 to 14 the second and a Special the third, with the whole thing marked as a man alert. H checks wide as the outlet.
concepts.progression: 1 Snag, 2 Basic, 3 Special; Check Wide outlet
concepts.qb: Dropback. Alert man. Can to the zone answer.

concepts.summary: A motion man comes across and the trips side runs Snag at 5, an Under T.O. at 5 and a Special, with a Go alert outside. H runs Coin and checks coin at 2 to 4 as the outlet.
concepts.progression: 1 Snag, 2 Under T.O., 3 Special; Go is the alert
concepts.qb: Dropback. Can to the zone answer.

positions.H: Coin; Check Coin outlet at 2 to 4 yds
positions.motion: Z motion (first cell) or F motion (second cell)

concepts.summary: Three crossers at stacked depths, all caught on the move: a low shallow cross at 5, a depth-set shallow cross at 7 and a Deep Sit at 10 to 12 whose man keeps his eyes on the QB. H runs a Rail. The tagged man sets which receiver carries which cross.
concepts.progression: Numbers 1 to 4; H Rail is 1, Eyes is 3; the rest unclear
concepts.qb: Dropback. Can to the zone answer.

positions.low cross: S.C. (Low) at 5 yds, on the move
positions.depth set: S.C. (Depth Set) at 7 yds, on the move
positions.deep sit: Deep Sit at 10 to 12 yds, eyes on the QB
positions.tagged: F, X or Z on the call line; which cross he takes is unclear

concepts.summary: Empty Braves from a bunch: the same three crossers (low at 5, depth set at 7, Deep Sit at 10 to 12 with eyes on the QB), a Shallow at 5 and a Corner at 12 as the alert. H Go sends H deep instead.
concepts.qb: Dropback. Can to the zone answer.

positions.low cross: S.C. (Low) at 5 yds, on the move
positions.depth set: S.C. (Depth Set) at 7 yds, on the move
positions.deep sit: Deep Sit at 10 to 12 yds, eyes on the QB

concepts.summary: New York is a quick empty package: a Stomp Now in 1 step, a Special, and a Locked Thunder at 6 with a Stomp. F runs Steal in the first cell; X runs Coin at 5 in the second with a Go (Yes/No) and an 18 to 20 yd route outside.
concepts.progression: 1, 2, 3 printed; Stomp Now and Special lead, order unclear
concepts.qb: Dropback. Go is Yes/No in the Coin cell. Can to the zone answer.
alerts: Alerts printed on both cells, targets unclear

concepts.summary: Empty package with Glances outside, an Under at 5 and a Shallow underneath, and H on a Rail. Three reads printed, no alerts.
concepts.qb: Dropback. Can to the zone answer.

concepts.summary: F runs Mexico, a High Cross at 18 to 22 between the numbers and the hash, with Z on a Blazer that sets the depth. Bang Flats at 2 to 3 are the outlets and the fifth man slams first. Scrabble protection.
concepts.qb: Dropback off Scrabble. Can to the zone answer.

positions.F: Mexico: High Cross at 18 to 22 yds between the numbers and the hash
positions.H: Bang Flat at 2 to 3 yds, outlet
